name: Johnny Test
description: Young Johnny is gung-ho and full of courage. Johnny's brainiac twin sisters, Susan and Mary, use Johnny as their guinea pig for their outrageous scientific experiments. If they can dream it up, Johnny will do it; as long as his genetically engineered super dog, Dukey, can come along.

videos.title: Johnny to the Center of the Earth
videos.overview: Things have been mysteriously disappearing underground, making Johnny and Dukey believe that the people behind this are "mole people". When Johnny accidentally loses his dad's new camera, he must journey to the center of the earth to retrieve it before dinnertime, or he will be grounded.

videos.title: Johnny X
videos.overview: Susan and Mary give Gil a piece of their special love "bubble gum", but by accident, it makes him transform. In order to save Gil and the others in pork belly, they have to give Johnny and Dukey some cool super powers.

videos.title: Johnny vs. Bling-Bling Boy
videos.overview: Bling-Bling Boy has stolen a device that turns things into gold and Johnny must get it back before dinnertime.

videos.title: Johnny Impossible
videos.overview: Johnny tries to get his baseball back from an old man before the baseball game starts.

videos.title: Johnny Test: Party Monster
videos.overview: Susan and Mary are having a party and use a device on Johnny in order to make him look good so all the girls at the party will love him, but Johnny turns into a monster.

videos.title: Johnny Test: Extreme Crime Stopper
videos.overview: The Extreme Teen Team are on the loose and it's up to Johnny to bring them down.

videos.title: Deep Sea Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny uses an invention to breathe underwater, yet sharks and electric eels begin to walk on land and wreak havoc to the beach.

videos.title: Johnny and the Amazing Turbo Action Backpack
videos.overview: Bling-Bling Boy steals a backpack and Johnny must retrieve it so Susan and Mary can show it off at the school science fair.

videos.title: Johnny and the Ice Pigs
videos.overview: Johnny goes back in time to ask Thomas Edison for a hockey invention and then to gather all of the vicious and ruthless "legends" he could find, in order to form a hockey team which will help the Ice Pigs win a game.

videos.title: Johnny’s House of Horrors
videos.overview: Johnny fills the house with some of Hugh's favorite things listed in his notebook. However, Johnny learns that the book was also full of Hugh's least favorite things (most of them scary.) To make matters worse, Lila's boss is coming over for dinner that night.

videos.title: Johnny’s Super Smartypants
videos.overview: Johnny wears super smarty pants in order to win the love of a genius girl, Janet Nelson Jr. But later, the pants get a mind of their own.

videos.title: Take Your Johnny to Work Day
videos.overview: Johnny sneaks into Lila's car along with Susan and Mary on Take Your Daughter to Work Day, thinking that it's unfair that girls don't have to go to school on this day, but boys do. When the kids get to Lila's workplace, they sneak into a lab and accidentally release a missile.

videos.title: Johnny and the Mega Roboticles
videos.overview: Johnny brings a toy, Nasteria, to life. But the toy decides to destroy Porkbelly. Now Johnny needs to stop the evil action figure with a toy force, led by Nasteria's arch enemy, Mega Roboticle.

videos.title: Johnny Gets Mooned
videos.overview: Johnny steals a rocket his sisters made to travel to the moon so he can write his report. Unexpectedly, he battles some moon monsters and rescues Canadian astronauts.

videos.title: Johnny Hollywood
videos.overview: Johnny uses a gadget to travel into a movie, The Quickest and the Monkiest. But what happens when the gadget gets stuck and the movie has a bad ending?

videos.title: Johnny's Turbo Time Rewinder
videos.overview: Johnny's sisters invent a time rewinder that can go back up to 5 minutes and they use it to get Johnny in trouble. Infuriated, he tries multiple times to steal this, but he fails; eventually, he gets a similar one from Bling-Bling Boy.

videos.title: Return of Johnny X
videos.overview: Johnny becomes Johnny X again in order to take down Bling-Bling's latest evil invention, Repto-Slicer.

videos.title: Sonic Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey try Susan and Mary's ultimate scooter and are wanted in the future.

videos.title: Dog Days of Johnny
videos.overview: Susan and Mary put a device on Dukey, making him respond to their every command. Now Johnny must stop Susan and Mary, and get his best friend back.

videos.title: Johnny's Pink Plague
videos.overview: Johnny uses a device to free everyone of zits.

videos.title: Johnny's Extreme Game Controller
videos.overview: Johnny uses his game controller to control people, but Hugh gets his hands on it and begins affecting Johnny in the process.

videos.title: Li'l Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny accidentally shrinks himself and Dukey into a sub-atomic universe while shrinking his toys. Unexpectedly, its nature turns against him.

videos.title: Johnny vs. Brain Freezer
videos.overview: A kid at Susan and Mary's school becomes a villain named Brain Freezer. Now Johnny must stop this villain and unfreeze everyone he froze.

videos.title: Johnny's Big Snow Job
videos.overview: Johnny uses a device in Susan and Mary's lab to make it snow outside.

videos.title: Johnny Dodgeball
videos.overview: Johnny uses a bionic arm to magnify his arm strength to beat Sissy at dodge ball. However, it breaks after being exposed to cereal.

videos.title: Johnny and the Attack of the Monster Truck
videos.overview: Eugene brings a living monster truck to the Test house, and it began to be enraged after Eugene kicked it because it didn't win Susan's heart. Now the truck wants to destroy the entire monster truck species. It's up to Johnny to figure out how to stop it.

videos.title: Hoist the Johnny Roger
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey must help a pathetic pirate, Nobeard, take down his powerful brother pirate, Blackbeard, and impress his father, Greybeard. Johnny goes back to the future to get his sisters' help.

videos.title: Johnny's Turbo Toy Force
videos.overview: An evil toymaker named Wacko gives out robots to all the children of Porkbelly, which imprison them. The gang seeks assistance from the Turbo Toy Force.

videos.title: JTV
videos.overview: Johnny starts his own channel over a channel which only broadcast emergencies and tests. Later, the army needs the channel for a runaway plane.

videos.title: Johnny vs. Bling-Bling Boy 2
videos.overview: Eugene creates a device that turns himself, Johnny, and Dukey into young children, interfering with Johnny's video game showdown with Sissy.

videos.title: Johnnyland
videos.overview: Johnny makes a theme park called Johnnyland in the backyard. However, Hugh demands the park be torn down, later stumbling into an unstable ride with Lila.

videos.title: Johnny's Got a Brand New Dad
videos.overview: Hugh's constant sayings of "no" begin to infuriate Johnny, so, with Susan and Mary's help, they make a new one. However, when the new dad gets exposed to the plutonium he got for Susan and Mary, things start to turn out ugly.

videos.title: Saturday's Alright for Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny is trying to have the perfect Saturday, but Sissy ruins it by trying to practice William Tell archery on Johnny. Johnny then uses Susan and Mary's Saturday Repeater machine to try again.

videos.title: Johnny Mint Chip
videos.overview: Johnny, Dukey, and the sisters go to an ice cream factory, in order to get the recipe for mint chip ice cream which Johnny and Dukey can't stop eating.

videos.title: Johnny's Pet Day
videos.overview: Dukey gets jealous when Johnny takes Repto-Slicer to school for pet day and not him. However, this lands him into danger of becoming a TV star.

videos.title: Phat Johnny
videos.overview: An accident in Eugene's lab leaves Johnny overweight like him. Johnny uses his weight to become a rapper and to get a video game that he wanted. However, karma is after him and ruins his experience.

videos.title: The Revenge of Johnny X
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey must rescue Susan from Bling-Bling Boy in the forms of Johnny X and Super Pooch. Little do they know she doesn't want to be rescued, as Bling-Bling Boy has taken her on a cruise bot with a swimming pool, movie theater, anti-gravity chamber, video arcade, and her favorite restaurants among other luxuries.

videos.title: The Enchanted Land of Johnnia
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey catch rainy day boredom, and use one of the sisters' devices, thinking that it is an inter-dimensional travel machine, and go into a land known as Johnnia.

videos.title: 101 Johnnies
videos.overview: Johnny makes 100 robot clones in order to do his chores for him, but the clones become defective soon after.

videos.title: Johnny Zombie Tea Party
videos.overview: Johnny brings Porkbelly's founders back to life in order to help with his report.

videos.title: Johnny Test in Black & White
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey shrink themselves, and end up in Mr. Black's stomach and brain to make him forget that the General told Mr. Black and Mr. White to spy on Susan and Mary to stop them from doing dangerous experiments.

videos.title: Johnny the Kid
videos.overview: Johnny and his family go on vacation to a dude ranch on Susan and Mary's choice, but it is invaded by an outlaw motorcycle club shortly after they arrive. With the help from Bling-Bling Boy and Gil, both whom have also been taken a trip to the ranch, the Tests resolve to stop the bikers from ruining their fun and take back their holiday.

videos.title: Downhill Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny goes to the Behemoth, the ultimate downhill ski resort. However, he has to find ways to go downhill since the ski captain doesn't let kids go.

videos.title: Johnny Meets the Pork-Ness Monsters
videos.overview: It is a hot day and Johnny's family cannot seem to find a place where they can cool off and get wet. They go to Lake Pork-Ness, which is rumored to have a monster inhabitant. Susan and Mary believe that the idea is a total myth and try to prove there are no monsters in the lake.

videos.title: Johnny X Strikes Back
videos.overview: Five evil villains who have been defeated previously by Johnny (Wacko, the Bee Keeper, Brain Freezer, Mr. Mittens and Albert the butler) team up and kidnap him. Now it's up to Susan, Mary, Dukey, Bling-Bling, Gil, and Bumper to save him.

videos.title: Johnny vs. Super Soaking Cyborgs
videos.overview: Susan and Mary create Gil cyborgs to make Gil jealous but they try to eliminate Gil and anyone in their path. It's up to Johnny to stop them. Meanwhile, the girls keep Gil "safe" in a box in their lab.

videos.title: 00-Johnny
videos.overview: Tim Burnout steals blueprints of the girls' original plan to alternate Dukey and uses it on his cat, Mr. Mittens. But he becomes evil and now it's up to Johnny and Dukey to stop him.

videos.title: Johnny of the Jungle
videos.overview: While on a class trip to the safari park with Dukey disguised as Johnny's dad, Johnny and Dukey decide to help animals get to their homeland in Africa.

videos.title: Johnny vs. Smash Badger 3
videos.overview: While trying to figure out some cheat codes from his video game, Johnny accidentally brings Smash Badger to life.

videos.title: Johnny Bee Good
videos.overview: The Bee Keeper steals all the candy in Porkbelly and it's up to Johnny, Dukey, and the girls to stop him.

videos.title: The Good, the Bad & the Johnny
videos.overview: To control Johnny's frequent bad behavior, the girls split his bad genes to make his genes 100% good. The bad gene later gets a life of its own, making two Johnnys, one nice and one evil.

videos.title: Rock-a-Bye Johnny
videos.overview: Dukey keeps Johnny up all night with his pillow fights and Johnny goes to the sisters to get some sleep. But Johnny misfires and causes his parents to go sleepwalking.

videos.title: Johnny vs. Bling-Bling Boy 3
videos.overview: When Eugene finds out that Johnny is what stands in the way of him and Susan, he sets out to lock Johnny up forever as he tries to get the last ingredient for his sister's "Susan-hating lozenge".

videos.title: Stinkin' Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny wants to buy an HDTV and the twins need an important ingredient for their experiment. The only solution: Enter Johnny in a professional wrestling competition so they can win $10,000, so they make Johnny a wrestling suit which allows him to spray stink gas from his suit.

videos.title: Johnny X and the Attack of the Snowmen
videos.overview: Brain Freezer creates an army of snowmen, and only Johnny X can stop him.

videos.title: Johnny vs. Dukey
videos.overview: After Johnny and Dukey send Bumper packing, they start to come against each other in a game of "Say Uncle".

videos.title: Here Johnny, Here Boy
videos.overview: Fed up with the lack of respect, Dukey has convinced Mary and Susan to turn Johnny into a dog. In the meantime Mary and Susan turn themselves into animals so they can get loved by Gil. It all goes wrong when Animal Control arrives and snatches them.

videos.title: Johnny Applesauce
videos.overview: After hearing about American heroes in Social Studies class, Johnny decides to help his classmates by bringing back applesauce as a vigilante after the Lunch Lady outlaws it. However, this lands him into trouble.

videos.title: Johnny'mon
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey are transported into their favorite video game, Tiny'Mon, but they end up trapped and must defeat Blast Ketchup, and his Tiny'Mon Kadoomerang, to get back home, with only the seemingly useless Cuddlebuns for protection.

videos.title: Bath Time for Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny refuses to bathe, and his family forcibly attempts to wash him. Meanwhile, Dukey is mad because he thinks Johnny forgot his birthday.

videos.title: Johnny Test: Monster Starter
videos.overview: Mr. Black and Mr. White ask Susan and Mary to design a new weapon, so they make a helmet that allows the user to control things with their mind. But it becomes a huge mistake when it's stuck on Johnny's head, and his obsession with a new video game now makes any inanimate object he sees turn into a monster.

videos.title: Johnny Holiday
videos.overview: Johnny is upset because the holidays that give free candy to the world are spread too far apart, so Johnny decides to start his own holiday, known as Kids Get Free Candy Day, and try to spread free candy. When there are some adult protests against this holiday, Johnny, Dukey, Susan, and Mary gain an unlikely ally against this – the Beekeeper.

videos.title: Coming to a Johnny Near You
videos.overview: When Dukey explains how narration makes everything seem better, Johnny convinces Susan and Mary to make a reality warping megaphone, but it malfunctions.

videos.title: When Johnny Comes Marching Home
videos.overview: Johnny buys a video game which turns out to be a military plot to recruit an elite team of super soldiers, and then he must join the fight against a group of renegade penguins who are losing their home to global warming.

videos.title: Johnnyitis
videos.overview: Johnny drinks an unstable isotope so he can get sick and not have to study for a test for school. Unfortunately, not only does the isotope give him red spots and a purple tongue, if it's not cured within four hours, it's going to give him immense bloating, cause violent coughing, and eventually make him explode.

videos.title: Johnny Mustache
videos.overview: Johnny has his sisters use an invention that will give him a mustache so that Johnny can get into a movie meant for older people. But when Bling Bling Boy pesters Johnny to use the invention on him, Johnny shoots the invention at him too much and now Eugene looks like the monster from a movie.

videos.title: Johnny Fu
videos.overview: When Bumper uses kung fu moves to take over the school, Johnny seeks Dukey's kung fu advice, but to no avail.

videos.title: Johnny Escape From Bling-Bling Island
videos.overview: Bling-Bling Boy steals Susan and Mary's shoes, and it is up to Johnny and a reluctant Dukey to retrieve them before their dinner with Gil.

videos.title: Johnny's Monkey Business
videos.overview: Susan and Mary need to get Lolo away from Johnny and Dukey for various tests when they try to make a profit out of her in order to get a video game system.

videos.title: Johnny Bench
videos.overview: Johnny must make a bench for woodshop class or he goes to summer school.

videos.title: Johnny Long Legs
videos.overview: Doggone doggy adventures result when Susan and Mary fashion a mind-controlling obedience collar to tame Dukey's bad behavior. Then, the girls invent an acne cream.

videos.title: Johnny Test in Outer Space
videos.overview: While trying to find life on other planets, Johnny meets a leader from the planet Vegandon who attempts to destroy the Earth by sucking out its natural resources.

videos.title: Johnny Kart Racing
videos.overview: All Johnny and Dukey want is a simple bike race between the two of them; but everyone joins the race.

videos.title: Johnny Smells Good
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey test a perfume experiment and now everyone is attracted to them. They use this to their advantage, but it goes out of control.

videos.title: Return of Johnny'mon
videos.overview: Seeking revenge, Blast Ketchup sucks Hugh into the Tiny'Mon world, trying to suck Johnny in. Thinking he is one of Johnny's Tiny'Mon, he captures him. Johnny, Dukey, Susan, and Mary must stop him. To re-exit the game, they must win another battle with Blast.

videos.title: Johnny Dukey Doo
videos.overview: When a condemned hotel gets haunted by ghosts Susan and Mary drag Johnny, Dukey and Gil into the house to prove that the ghosts are fake.

videos.title: Johnny X: A New Beginning
videos.overview: It's time for the Earth Day Carnival and the Johnny Stopping Evil Force 5 (with Zizrar replacing the Beekeeper) returns and obtains the same mutant powers as Johnny X, and Super Dukey.

videos.title: Johnny X: The Final Ending
videos.overview: Following the events right after "JX6-a: A New Beginning" Dark Vegan returns to destroy the Earth with an upgraded armada. Dark Vegan, with his upgrade armada, is cutting up the Earth's trees, taking off the oxygen and sucking up the Earth's water. Johnny, Dukey, and the Johnny Stopping Evil Force 5 team up to stop Dark Vegan and return the Earth's resources.

videos.title: Johnny's New Baby Sisters
videos.overview: Susan and Mary purposely turn themselves into babies while the parents are out, and Johnny has to keep them safe from the irresponsible babysitter Gil; this interferes with a party he and Dukey had been planning.

videos.title: Porta Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny tricks his sisters into letting him have teleporting powers. Susan and Mary mess with the powers to get revenge. Later the twins accidentally get them caught in a middle of an art robbery.

videos.title: Join the Johnny Scouts
videos.overview: After Johnny lands his bike into a garbage truck, he becomes a Lady Bird Scout and tries to sell 1,000 boxes of cookies to get a new one. Little does he know, Sissy wants the bike as well, but for a better reason.

videos.title: Johnny BC
videos.overview: Johnny goes back in time in order to get a sloth bone for the twins, but when he returns he becomes a caveman, interfering with his grounding from selling Hugh's personal items.

videos.title: Runaway Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey run away when Johnny's parents say he's old enough to do chores but not old enough to watch PG-13 movies.

videos.title: Johnny on the Spot
videos.overview: Johnny steals a portable black hole, which later creates an early apocalypse.

videos.title: Dark Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny joins forces with Dark Vegan to get him back to his home planet.

videos.title: No Homework for Johnny
videos.overview: Susan and Mary build Johnny a robot in order to help him do his homework, but the robot ends up stealing things for Johnny.

videos.title: Papa Johnny
videos.overview: Susan and Mary switch Johnny and Hugh's brains after the two make a bet that involves taking on each other's lives.

videos.title: The Johnnyminster Dog Show
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey try to get in a dog show which only allows perfectly groomed and trained dogs.

videos.title: Dukey Jekyll and Johnny Hyde
videos.overview: Dukey drinks a liquid which makes him turn into a monster. To make matters worse, a dog catcher (and later Mr. Black and Mr. White) are after him.

videos.title: Johnny's Trophy Case
videos.overview: Johnny wants to get a trophy to put in his trophy case. Susan and Mary get obsessed with winning, so the three of them enter The Pork Belly River Jumpoff to win 1 million dollars and a trophy.

videos.title: Johnny's Amazing Cookie Company
videos.overview: Susan and Mary make fortune cookies that come true, and Johnny sells them with the typical drastic results.

videos.title: Johnny's Big Dumb Sisters
videos.overview: The twins' latest invention accidentally makes them dumb thanks to Johnny right before their scholarship interview.

videos.title: My Johnny Guard
videos.overview: Johnny gets hired to stop Bling-bling from kissing Susan, but Johnny turns on the sisters once Bling-Bling bribes him.

videos.title: Tom and Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny turns into a mouse for Susan and Mary, but when Mr. Mittens comes, things get chaotic. This episode is a parody of Tom and Jerry.

videos.title: The Quantum of Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny tries to get invited to a party to stop a villain. NOTE: Susan and Mary don't appear in this episode.

videos.title: Johnny Get Yer Gum
videos.overview: Mr. Whacko invents a new helium gum that lifts kids into the sky, and Johnny must save them.

videos.title: Old School Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny travels to 1845 when school was easier, but he gets stuck there because the power supplier to the Turbo Time Tea house hasn't been invented yet. The sisters and Johnny try to find outdated technology to power the tea house.

videos.title: Johnny Degrees Below Zero
videos.overview: Johnny creates a magnetic force field on the Earth which makes Porkbelly the new north pole.

videos.title: Johnny Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey get framed for stuff that Johnny and Dukey look alike robots (which Mr. Black and Mr. White made) do around Porkbelly.

videos.title: Johnny Double Coupons
videos.overview: Johnny keeps attempting to ride down Suicide hill, but Susan and Mary keep redeeming Johnny's coupons.

videos.title: X-Ray Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny gets X-Ray goggles.

videos.title: The Destruction of Johnny X
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey decide to remain in super hero mode permanently but find being a superhero is harder than they think.

videos.title: iJohnny
videos.overview: The twins upgrade Johnny's new cell phone. Later the phone becomes too intelligent and begins hacking government space missiles.

videos.title: Johnny vs. The Mummy
videos.overview: Johnny goes on a trip to the museum and brings the things to life, including a mummy.

videos.title: Johnny Grow Your Own Monster
videos.overview: Johnny's mail order foam monster becomes a real monster once the twins swap the water with their bottle of "side effects".

videos.title: Who's Johnny
videos.overview: When Sissy considers Johnny too gross to help her in a science project, he begs Susan and Mary to change his personality.

videos.title: Princess Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny poses as a princess in order to prevent a war. Meanwhile, Susan and Mary decide that they would like to act like normal girls.

videos.title: 99 Deeds of Johnny Test
videos.overview: After getting his 99th detention, Johnny learns he must perform 99 good deeds or he will be sent to military school.

videos.title: Johnny's Amazing Race
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey challenge his sisters, their friends, and their enemies to a survival challenge in which the winning team gets hundreds of dollars in gift certificates.

videos.title: Johnny Test in 3D
videos.overview: While the tests go on vacation, Johnny and Dukey try to get back into their hotel room and avoid the hotel manager that doesn't allow pets.

videos.title: Guess Who's Coming to Johnny's for Dinner
videos.overview: Mr. Black moves in with the Tests after he embarrasses Mr. White at the dance contest auditions.

videos.title: Johnny's New BFF
videos.overview: Johnny's parents keep setting Johnny up with new friends. When those don't work out, Johnny reveals Dukey's intelligence. Later, Dukey spends more time helping Johnny's parents instead of playing with Johnny.

videos.title: Johnny vs. Bling Bling IV
videos.overview: Johnny once again has to protect Susan from Bling Bling Boy who is determined to have her as his valentine.

videos.title: Johnny's Big Sister Smackdown
videos.overview: Susan and Mary both want Gil to go on a date with them, so they put up a wrestling match using rough guts (Susan uses Johnny's while Mary uses a lion's), but it leads to destructive results.

videos.title: Sunshine Malibu Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny goes to the beach to surf, but there are no waves, so Susan and Mary build a wave making machine and special surfboard for him.

videos.title: Johnnyicle
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey try to help Brain Freezer get a girlfriend.

videos.title: King Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny becomes obsessed with domination after Susan and Mary bring his chess pieces to life.

videos.title: Johnny Re-Animated
videos.overview: Johnny uses one of his sisters' inventions to bring two cartoon characters to the real world in order to scare Sissy out of the house, but the characters mistake Porkbelly for a zombie world and try to destroy it.

videos.title: Johnny Cakes
videos.overview: It's Lila's birthday and the family spends the morning to make her birthday a success. Johnny struggles to make her breakfast, Hugh tries to figure out a good but inexpensive gift for her, and the twins keep trap Lila in her bedroom until Hugh and Johnny are ready.

videos.title: Johnny Tube
videos.overview: Johnny wants to become a internet sensation.

videos.title: Sleepover at Johnny's
videos.overview: Johnny is dragged into Susan and Mary's plan to get Gil to be in a sleep-over, but Bling-Bling Boy and Dark Vegan's daughter Jillian become involved as well, with the usual chaos ensuing.

videos.title: Johnny's Got a Wart!
videos.overview: Johnny gets a wart, and when his sisters try to get rid of it, it gives the wart intelligence and seems to make Johnny's life better, but he tries to take over his body as he gets more powerful.

videos.title: Johnny's Royal Flush
videos.overview: When Susan and Mary turns Johnny into a fish as part of one of their experiments, Hugh flushes him down the toilet by mistake where he ends up in the sewer, and he has to swim for his life when he runs into an alligator.

videos.title: Johnny Test's Day Off
videos.overview: Johnny ditches school with a relentless truant officer in hot pursuit.

videos.title: Johnny & Dark Vegan's Battle Brawl Mania
videos.overview: Dark Vegan once again tries to destroy Johnny, who is trying to cheer up lonely Repto-Slicer.

videos.title: A Scholarship for Johnny
videos.overview: Hugh wants to train Johnny to be good at sports so that he could get a sports scholarship to college.

videos.title: Johnny Boat Racing
videos.overview: Johnny, his friends, and his enemies all compete in a boat race against an arrogant rowing team.

videos.title: Johnny Lock Down
videos.overview: Johnny is determined to get a flytrap plant from his sisters for his school's science fair.

videos.title: Good Ol' Johnny Test
videos.overview: Johnny is in charge of the school play about recycling while Susan and Mary create a garbage-eating monster.

videos.title: Johnny X Strikes Back Again
videos.overview: The general takes away the lab, and than builds agent cyborgs. They charge up Johnny X and their friends to stop them!

videos.title: Johnny Goes Nuts
videos.overview: Johnny is finally old enough to participate in Porkbelly’s Annual Running of the Squirrels, but he has to get past Lila, who thinks it’s too dangerous, despite performing many dangerous attempts on her son to stop him.

videos.title: Johnny Daddy Day
videos.overview: Johnny, the twins and Lila realize it’s Father’s Day, and they don’t have a gift. They try many disastrous attempts, making Hugh wish they had never remembered!

videos.title: Johnny Cruise
videos.overview: Johnny wins an ocean cruise for him and his family, but it turns to be just a trap by Bling-Bling Boy, who deliberately crashes the ship so he can romantically save Susan.

videos.title: Rated J for Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny tries various schemes to buy an M-rated video game, not knowing what the consequences will be.

videos.title: Spotless Johnny
videos.overview: After Johnny and Dukey track mud in the house, they use a special stain-remover designed by Susan and Mary, but also learn it can make Johnny invisible.

videos.title: Johnny vs. Bling-Bling: The Ultimate Battle
videos.overview: Tired of all of the Johnny vs. Bling Bling battles with no winner, the Test sisters and Bling-Bling's science team make a bet to see who is the final winner of the battles.

videos.title: Cat Scratch Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey bring characters in a science-fiction movie to life with Susan and Mary's 3-D glasses, and now the aliens in the movie want to conquer the Earth.

videos.title: Johnny of the Deep
videos.overview: Mary turns Johnny and Dukey into sharks when Bling Bling Boy hypnotizes Susan into falling in love with him.

videos.title: Johnny Swellville
videos.overview: A time-traveling mishap sends Johnny and Dukey back to the 1950s.

videos.title: Johnny Irresistible
videos.overview: Johnny wants to increase his charisma when he becomes jealous of Gil's popularity.

videos.title: Johnny's Rat Race
videos.overview: Johnny uses his sisters' genetically altered rat for a school project, only to have it stolen by a desperate circus owner to save his failing show.

videos.title: Black & White & Johnny All Over
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey help Mr. Black and Mr. White catch a runaway robot dog before it explodes.

videos.title: Lawn Gone Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny, his friends, and his enemies compete with each other in a lawn mower race.

videos.title: Johnny's Ultimate Treehouse
videos.overview: Johnny "borrows" his sisters' worker drones to build the ultimate treehouse to impress Sissy, but ultimately ends up failing.

videos.title: Johnny Goes Camping
videos.overview: When Johnny is ordered by his school to go camping with his father, he uses his sisters' ray gun to turn Dukey into a monster to scare his father out of it, only to have Bigfoot fall in love with monster Dukey.

videos.title: Johnny's World Prank Wars I
videos.overview: Johnny competes with his family, his friends, and his enemies in a prank war. Error: When Johnny said to Dukey an escape plan, Dukey said look it's Gill.When Mr. Mittens [ aka.Super kitty prakster S.P.K. for short.] said I can't beleve you fell for it meanen it was a prank.

videos.title: How to Become a John-i Knight
videos.overview: Aliens from a meat-themed planet ask Johnny to protect their home world from Dark Vegan who wants to destroy it out of frustration because of his failure to make the perfect toast.

videos.title: The Return of Johnny Super Smarty Pants
videos.overview: The Super Smarty Pants possesses an Eskimo to get to Johnny, where it kicks him away and possesses Johnny, making him the smartest kid in school. Not wanting to be outsmarted, his sisters go to great lengths to de-pants him.

videos.title: Fangs a Lot Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny accidentally turns his sisters into vampires, and has to save Gil from getting bitten by his lovestruck vampire sisters and change them back.

videos.title: Johnny Testosterone
videos.overview: Johnny eats all of the peach yogurt, not knowing that each container is filled with growth serum, and becomes a Hulk monster, causing destruction.

videos.title: Johnny's Keys to Success
videos.overview: Susan and Mary make a key for Johnny that can open any lock in Porkbelly, but people try to steal it for their own benefits.

videos.title: Johnny's Winter Jacket
videos.overview: When Johnny's mom makes him wear a big winter coat, he is teased at school. However, Mr. Black, Mr. White, and the General ask Susan and Mary to make some sort of weapon to destroy aliens if they ever attacked, so they make Johnny's jacket the weapon.

videos.title: Johnny Two-Face
videos.overview: Tired of Johnny's constant lying, Susan and Mary attach a second mouth to him that does nothing but tell the truth.

videos.title: Johnny Susan, Susan Johnny
videos.overview: Susan swaps bodies with Johnny so that she and Mary can get a men-only science award.

videos.title: Johnny Trick or Treat
videos.overview: Johnny spends the night in a haunted house with Dukey and Jillian to win a ton of candy.

videos.title: Nightmare on Johnny's Street
videos.overview: Johnny stays up half the night to watch a six-hour Halloween monster-movie marathon, then steals his sisters' dream machine (thinking it to be an alarm clock) so that he will be able to wake up in time for school the next day; however, he has nightmares during the night which the device brings to life.

videos.title: My Dinner with Johnny
videos.overview: Tired of Johnny's repulsive eating habits, Hugh challenges him to a bet to see if he can go one full meal without complaining about his food or making rude noises.

videos.title: Johnny Alternative
videos.overview: When Johnny and Dukey get tired of the same old Porkbelly, they ask the girls to make it seem more fun. But they accidentally get sent to an alternate universe where they find that everyone (including themselves) is the opposite gender.

videos.title: Cool Hand Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey try to escape when they are imprisoned by Wacko in a video game.

videos.title: Roller Johnny
videos.overview: Susan and Mary turn Johnny and Dukey into girls so that they can win the grand prize at a roller derby match, but things quickly get difficult when a blow on the head gives Dukey amnesia, and he thinks that he is a real derby queen.

videos.title: A Holly Johnny Christmas
videos.overview: The Tests try to get Johnny a new toy when it sells out in the local shopping mall.

videos.title: Johnny's First Annual Snowball
videos.overview: Johnny invites everyone to his house for a snowball fight, but forgets to put the word "fight" on the invitation, which misleads everyone into believing it's actually a "Snow Ball" dance.

videos.title: Lakeside Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny heads to summer camp and battles in a boating competition against rival rich-kid campers.

videos.title: Johnny Germ Fighter
videos.overview: Johnny's dad gets fed up with his filthy bathroom and demands Johnny to clean it up but when Johnny uses his sisters' special germ foam and his dad's cleaning products, problems arise as it causes the germs to grow out of control.

videos.title: Johnny's World Record
videos.overview: Johnny is determined to break a world record so he can get into the Frothy Book Of Crazy, Inane & Useless Records.

videos.title: Mush, Johnny, Mush
videos.overview: Johnny, his friends, and his enemies take on a snooty rich boy in a dog sled race.

videos.title: Johnny's Treasure
videos.overview: Johnny, Dukey, and the girls set out to find the treasure of Pie-Eyed Pat when they find his treasure map in the attic.

videos.title: Extra Credit Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny must do some extra credit for school, or he will fail the course and have to make it up in summer school.

videos.title: Johnny's Left Foot
videos.overview: When Johnny breaks his foot in a dangerous stunt, which Hugh and Lila ground him for, his sisters step up to create a robotic one for him.

videos.title: Johnny vs. The Tickler
videos.overview: Angry at Johnny for having Wacko put in jail, his brother The Tickler decides it's time for him to stop Johnny once and for all, so he kidnaps Susan and Mary and takes their lab, forcing Johnny to seek help in unexpected places.

videos.title: Bugged Out Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey try to catch bugs, only to come upon a ladybug with a voracious appetite.

videos.title: Johnny Test's Quest
videos.overview: Bling-Bling tries to get Susan once again, but his henchmen soon rebel against him by tying him up with Susan.

videos.title: Johnny-O's
videos.overview: Sick of cheap cereal prizes that don't work, Johnny decides to make himself a new breakfast cereal. But everything goes haywire when Johnny decides to put in real ray guns made by his twin sisters, and the entire town of Porkbelly becomes a city of chaos and destruction of what anyone chooses to destroy.

videos.title: It's Du-Kay Johnny
videos.overview: When Dukey's DNA begins to degrade, reverting him into a normal dog, the girls attempt to upgrade it, but their upgrade goes overboard, turning Dukey into a rich, snooty dog.

videos.title: Magic Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny tries to prove to Sissy that he can do magic so he gets his sisters to help him.

videos.title: Dolly Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny disagrees to help the girls test experiments so they create a special doll that can control Johnny but Johnny seeks revenge and creates special dolls that can control the girls.

videos.title: Johnny McCool
videos.overview: Johnny becomes Speed McCool's new stunt man.

videos.title: It's an Invasion, Johnny
videos.overview: Black and White get into trouble in outer space and the kids must save them.

videos.title: It's All Relative, Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey go back in time to meet Johnny's ancestor in order to write a report about him.

videos.title: Johnny Rich
videos.overview: The Tests become rich when they sell one of Susan and Mary's inventions, but Bling Bling is jealous and goes to war with them.

videos.title: Johnny X... Again? (JX9)
videos.overview: Johnny visits Reptoslicer and his family, but Reptoslicer then tries to eat Porkbelly.

videos.title: Green Johnny
videos.overview: When Earth Day approaches, Johnny is visited by three ghosts.

videos.title: Johnny on the Clock
videos.overview: Johnny hopes to extend summer vacation with Susan and Mary's time-stopping watch.

videos.title: Johnny X-Factor (JX10)
videos.overview: Johnny X battles Boy Drone X.

videos.title: Johnny Vets Dukey
videos.overview: Johnny chases Dukey, who refuses to go to the vet.

videos.title: Johnny's No. 1 Fan
videos.overview: Johnny takes on Dark Vegan with help from a fan.

videos.title: How to Train Your Johnny
videos.overview: Susan and Mary accidentally wipe Johnny's memory.

videos.title: Johnny and Clyde
videos.overview: Susan and Mary's orangutan becomes a crook after watching old movies with Johnny. (NOTE: This is a parody of Bonnie and Clyde.

videos.title: Johnny's Super Massive Kart Wheelies 7
videos.overview: Johnny and the gang race in their video-game carts.

videos.title: Smooth Talking Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny swipes the girls' voice-replicating invention and ends up turning them against each other.

videos.title: Johnny and the Beanstalk
videos.overview: A giant cereal stalk takes Johnny and friends on a magical adventure.

videos.title: Johnny and Bling-Bling Bond Bond
videos.overview: Johnny tries to teach the grounded Bling Bling how to be a regular kid.

videos.title: Johnny's Got Talent
videos.overview: Johnny takes up ventriloquism for a talent contest.

videos.title: Johnny's Rough Around the Hedges
videos.overview: Johnny and Bling Bling sculpt topiaries after their parents force them to take up less destructive hobbies.

videos.title: Johnny's Head in the Clouds
videos.overview: The General puts Johnny and his friends under house arrest right when an awesome air show heads into town.

videos.title: Stop in the Name of Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny is late to class again, and he gets a visit to the principal's office which unexpectedly leads into Johnny becoming the new hall monitor of the school, due to someone named the Speedster (who is literally a speedster) delaying kids from getting to their classes. Johnny interrogates the school bully Bumper, who reveals the Speedster to be Sissy Blakely, so he "borrows" Susan and Mary inventions to try to catch Sissy.

videos.title: Johnny Opposite
videos.overview: Johnny steals Susan and Mary's generator and makes his family do the opposite of what they're doing.

videos.title: Johnny on the Job
videos.overview: Johnny's dad thinks he's not needed in the house so he decides to get a job. When nobody hires him, Susan and Mary make a fake office for their dad to work in.

videos.title: Johnny's 100th Episode
videos.overview: The girls test their new fantasy spray on Johnny which sends him into a coma. The girls and Johnny's friends must revive him back into reality.

videos.title: Johnny's Next Episode
videos.overview: Bling Bling Boy sprays fantasy spray on everyone (including himself) and they all turn into fairy tale characters.

videos.title: Johnny's Supreme Theme
videos.overview: Real life becomes a movie after Johnny and Dukey get their hands and paws on the girls' latest invention.

videos.title: Past and Present Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey visit the 1980s to get to the bottom of a video-game mystery.

videos.title: The Sands of Johnny
videos.overview: Sissy and Johnny face off in a sandcastle battle.

videos.title: Abominable Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey locate the Abominable Snowman during a ski vacation.

videos.title: Johnny vs. the Dukenator
videos.overview: Johnny must rescue Dukey, who falls under the control of a dog-spa owner.

videos.title: Johnny's Petting Zoo Posse
videos.overview: Johnny and his friends take on Mr. Mittens when he turns them, the girls, the general and Black and White into petting zoo animals as part of his latest evil plan.

videos.title: The Johnny Who Saved Halloween
videos.overview: Johnny and his friends enter a Halloween contest in hopes of winning a big candy prize.

videos.title: Johnny's Zombie Bomb
videos.overview: A love potion goes haywire and turns people into kissing zombies.

videos.title: Johnny's New Super Mega Villain
videos.overview: A new villain arrives in Porkbelly and steals high-tech devices from everyone, and Johnny must stop it.

videos.title: Johnny in Charge
videos.overview: Johnny stays home alone and must prove he's responsible.

videos.title: Johnny Unplugged
videos.overview: Johnny taps his video-game skills to save the family during a perilous hiking trip.

videos.title: Johnny's Monster Mash
videos.overview: Monsters created by the girls' experiments take aim at Porkbelly.

videos.title: Johnny's Chipmunk Chit Chat
videos.overview: Chipmunks plot world domination after a misleading chat with Johnny.

videos.title: A Picture's Worth 1000 Johnnies
videos.overview: Chaos erupts at the mall when the Tests try to pose for a family portrait.

videos.title: Dial J for Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey prank call historical figures using the girls' time machine.

videos.title: Road Trip Johnny
videos.overview: The Test family take a road trip to Upchuck Geysers.

videos.title: Code Cracking Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey cheat their way to victory in the Red Gush contest.

videos.title: Johnny Goes Viral
videos.overview: Johnny has unlimited knowledge after the girls insert a computer chip into his brain.

videos.title: FrankenJohnny
videos.overview: Johnny and Bling-Bling fall apart after an accident with the particle accelerator.

videos.title: The Johnny Express
videos.overview: Johnny runs into trouble delivering a package for the girls.

videos.title: Crash Test Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny quits as the girls' test subject and quickly regrets his decision.

videos.title: Johnny's Junky Trunk
videos.overview: Mr. Test donates Johnny's toys without asking.

videos.title: Super Johnny Action Federation
videos.overview: Johnny and the gang acquire super powers and compete to see who is the best superhero.

videos.title: Gil-Stopping Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny goes to extreme measures to prevent Gil from moving.

videos.title: Johnny With a Chance of Meatloaf
videos.overview: The kids make a vow to end Dad's meatloaf madness.

videos.title: It's Easter, Johnny Test!
videos.overview: Johnny must save Easter from the annual Easter-egg hunt ruined by Dark Vegan.

videos.title: Future Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny meets his future self.

videos.title: Dukey See Johnny Do
videos.overview: Johnny loses his sight.

videos.title: Hair's Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny is accidentally turned into a werewolf.

videos.title: Johnny's Hungry Games
videos.overview: All the pizza goes missing and Johnny must get it back.

videos.title: Tiny Johnny
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey try to catch a mouse.

videos.title: Johnny Goes Gaming
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey are trapped in a video game.

videos.title: The Last Flight of Johnny X (JX11)
videos.overview: Johnny X and Super Pooch lose their superpowers when the city is attacked.

videos.title: Johnny's Last Chapter
videos.overview: Johnny and Dukey are sucked into a history book.
